By the [Gaussian MLEs](#sec-gaussian-mle),
$\hmean_{\text{ML}} = \bar x$ and $\hvarpar_{\text{ML}} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_i (x_i - \bar x)^2$:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
mu_hat <- mean(glucose_data)
sigma_sq_hat <- mean((glucose_data - mu_hat)^2)
sigma_hat <- sqrt(sigma_sq_hat)
c(mu_hat = mu_hat, sigma_sq_hat = sigma_sq_hat)
```

@fig-hers-fitted superimposes the fitted Gaussian density on the histogram.

::: {#fig-hers-fitted}

```{r}
plot1 +
  ggplot2::geom_function(
    fun = function(x) dnorm(x, mean = mu_hat, sd = sigma_hat),
    col = "red"
  )
```

Fasting glucose, with the fitted Gaussian density in red

:::

The fitted curve follows the overall shape of the histogram,
but it underestimates the frequency of values between 110 and 122 mg/dL,
consistent with the histogram's longer right tail.
